removed.reason: With --exact-reachability-metadata the first WebSocket session hangs until the 60 s JUnit timeout: zio-http's server send waits forever on its handshakeCompleted promise. Running with -XX:MissingRegistrationReportingMode=Exit/Warn reports no missing registration, so metadata cannot fix it. The hang survived three run-time options (-Dio.netty.transport.noNative=true, -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2, plus the reporting-mode check) across 6 exact runs, and the same scenario also hangs on the JVM under the native-image agent. It passes only on the plain JVM and on images built without the exact-reachability flag.
